mod.thikermagic.name: Thiker Magic
modifier.thikermagic.mana_siphon.flavor: The bloom drinks deeper than you do.
modifier.thikermagic.mana_siphon.descrip: Restores 0.15 extra Ars Nouveau mana every tick per level (3 mana per second) while the tool is equipped or held.
modifier.thikermagic.spell_haste.descrip: Each level removes 8% of the cast cooldown applied after casting an Ars Nouveau spell.
modifier.thikermagic.arcane_attunement.d: Each level grants +10% maximum Ars Nouveau mana while the tool is equipped or held.
modifier.thikermagic.mana_reservoir.flav: A well that never quite runs dry.
modifier.thikermagic.mana_reservoir.desc: Grants +40% maximum mana and restores 0.5 extra mana every tick (10 mana per second).
modifier.thikermagic.arcane_surge.flavor: The next word leaves your mouth before you finish thinking it.
modifier.thikermagic.arcane_surge.descri: Removes 30% of the cast cooldown and restores 0.3 extra mana every tick (6 mana per second).
modifier.thikermagic.charged_core.flavor: Feed it and it bites harder.
modifier.thikermagic.charged_core.descri: Stores 10000 FE per level and can be charged from any Forge Energy source. Melee damage and attack speed scale with the charge, up to +20% damage and +50% attack speed at full charge. Every landed hit spends 100 FE.
modifier.thikermagic.lifesteal.descripti: Attacks restore health, at the cost of tool durability
modifier.thikermagic.creative_flight.des: When wearing the chestplate, allows creative-style flight
